comment.body: Thanks for the concrete report about Key Remapped to Volume Up presses B, Volume Down Presses C, including the version, affected PowerToys area, and observed behavior. The remaining ambiguity is the exact failing path or whether this still reproduces on a current build, so a generic checklist would not help. Please retest on the latest stable build and provide the exact keyboard model, layout, physical key, and remap; state whether the extra B/C events occur on every press and attach /bugreport immediately after reproducing. This will distinguish the competing triage paths and determine whether the proposed fix should target the reported behavior or a different configuration or lifecycle condition.
